central_thesis: Crisp repositioned from a 'human touch' differentiator for startups and SMBs into an AI-first platform serving broader business audiences, replacing emotional customer experience messaging with AI capability demonstration and replacing exploratory trial language with immediate AI agent deployment.
old_positioning_frame: A human-centered messaging platform emphasizing emotional connection and team collaboration, positioned specifically for startups and SMBs seeking an all-in-one solution
new_positioning_frame: An AI-powered transformation platform that positions the company as leading businesses through an AI-driven revolution, with AI agents as the primary entry point rather than general messaging capabilities
buyer_shift: Startup and SMB decision-makers seeking human-touch differentiation in customer support → businesses of any size actively seeking AI-driven automation and efficiency in customer interactions
funnel_shift: Mid-funnel exploration (14-day trial invitation, feature discovery) → top-of-funnel category ownership (AI agent as primary hook) with immediate deployment intent

main_evidence.old: Give your customer experience a human touch
main_evidence.new: Augment your customer experience. AI made to support your team & customers.
main_evidence.meaning: Signals a deliberate pivot from emotional/human differentiation to AI capability as the primary value proposition, suggesting the company believes AI-first messaging now resonates more strongly than human-touch positioning in their market

main_evidence.old: #1 Business Messaging Platform For Startups & SMB's - Crisp
main_evidence.new: The AI Customer Support Platform for Every Business - Crisp
main_evidence.meaning: Indicates an intentional broadening of target audience from niche (startups/SMBs) to universal ('every business'), while simultaneously narrowing category claim from general 'messaging' to specific 'AI customer support', suggesting confidence in owning a more specific AI-defined category

main_evidence.old: 14 Days free trial. No credit-card required. Try now ! We provide Knowledge base, Team Inbox, Chatbot, CRM and multiple other features
main_evidence.new: Crisp is leading businesses through the AI-driven revolution by using conversations to unlock hypergrowth
main_evidence.meaning: Removes all trial friction messaging and feature enumeration in favor of transformation narrative ('leading businesses through revolution', 'unlock hypergrowth'), suggesting a shift from friction-reduction tactics to vision-led positioning consistent with higher-confidence category leadership

main_evidence.old: Meet the business messaging platform that gathers customer support, sales, and marketing
main_evidence.new: Build your perfect AI Agent in 4 steps
main_evidence.meaning: Replaces product introduction framing with immediate AI agent construction as the first content block, signaling that the homepage now serves as an AI agent deployment path rather than a platform education journey

main_evidence.old: Get Started | Try Crisp for free | Request a demo
main_evidence.new: Get your AI Agent | Start Free Trial
main_evidence.meaning: Points to a change in conversion intent from exploration ('request a demo', 'try for free') to specific capability acquisition ('get your AI agent'), consistent with serving buyers who arrive with AI agent intent rather than general platform evaluation intent
Places 'AI Agent' as the primary navigation element, suggesting it now functions as the hero product or primary entry point rather than one feature among many in a suite

copy_this_if: Your product category is undergoing rapid AI disruption and buyer search behavior has shifted to include 'AI [your category]' as a dominant search pattern, and you have measurable evidence that prospects arrive asking specifically about AI capabilities rather than discovering them mid-evaluation
do_not_copy_this_if: Your AI capabilities are still experimental, or your target buyers actively distrust AI in your category (e.g., sectors requiring human judgment, highly regulated industries), or you lack the product depth to fulfill the AI-first promise without creating activation drop-off
safer_version_for_early_stage_saas: Test a secondary headline or subheadline that frames AI as an enhancement to your core value proposition (e.g., 'Human-touch customer support, AI-accelerated') rather than replacing your primary positioning, and measure whether adding 'AI-powered' to your meta description increases qualified traffic before committing to a full repositioning
risk_if_copied: Commoditization in an AI feature arms race if your AI capabilities are not substantively differentiated, alienation of existing customers who valued the 'human touch' positioning, and activation friction if users arrive expecting a fully autonomous AI agent but encounter a platform requiring significant configuration
